scope: Proposition 5.7 of the manuscript “Equality and rigidity in the spacetime Penrose inequality” (preprints/Equality-and-rigidity-in-the-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f1aab59ba484eb8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: One has W > 0 throughout int Ω. The static base metric h = g +W−1X♭ ⊗X♭ has a smooth one-sided attachment at S, with induced metric g|TS, and Hessh λ = λ Rich, ∆hλ = 0, Rh = 0, 0 < λ < 1, λ = √ W. (5.24) At the attached boundary S, |dλ|h = κ and the boundary is totally geodesic. The even reflection of h and odd reflection of λ are at least C2,α for 0 < α < 1.
